title: RTNav: Towards Real-Time Zero-Shot Object Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.26496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Navigation in unknown environments to find unforeseen objects has become increasingly feasible with capable vision and language foundation models. However, these models also introduce non-negligible inference latency, which becomes an important concern when agents must operate continuously in the real world. Most state-of-the-art methods are still developed in synchronous simulators, where the environment waits for the agent to act and inference time is effectively free. As a result, agents are often designed around the sequential execution of perception, reasoning, and action, with little regard for time constraints. Under real-time execution, where wall-clock time counts towards the task budget, the inefficiencies of these architectures become clear. We show that recent zero-shot object navigation methods suffer consistent performance degradation under such realistic timing conditions. Motivated by this observation, we propose RTNav,

translated_title: RTNav：迈向实时零样本物体导航
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26496v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在未知环境中导航以发现不可预见的物体，随着视觉和语言基础模型的能力增强，已变得越来越可行。然而，这些模型也引入了不可忽视的推理延迟，这在代理必须在现实世界中持续运行时成为一个重要关切。大多数最先进的方法仍在同步模拟器中开发，其中环境等待代理行动，推理时间实际上免费。因此，代理通常围绕感知、推理和行动的顺序执行而设计，很少考虑时间限制。在实时执行中，墙钟时间计入任务预算，这些架构的低效性变得明显。我们表明，最近的零样本物体导航方法在这种现实时间条件下会遭受一致的性能下降。受此观察的启发，我们提出RTNav。
tldr: RTNav通过重新设计架构以应对实时执行中的推理延迟，显著提升了零样本物体导航在真实时间条件下的性能。
en_tdlr: RTNav re-architects zero-shot object navigation to mitigate inference latency under real-time execution, substantially improving performance in realistic timing conditions.
